title: SKE Crystal Pro Kiwi Passionfruit Guava   Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Designed for use with the SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pods offer a seamless and cost-effective way to enjoy the brand’s signature flavours without the waste of disposable vapes. Each prefilled pod provides up to 600 puffs, depending on individual usage, and contains 2ml of 20mg nic salt e-liquid, ensuring a smooth and satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape with rapid nicotine relief. Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava delivers a tropical fruit medley that bursts with exotic flavour. The sharp tang of kiwi cuts through the sweet and fragrant notes of passion fruit, while guava adds a smooth and mellow undertone, creating a perfectly balanced and refreshing vape. Swapping pods is quick and effortless—simply remove the empty pod and pop a fresh one into place. Whether you’re looking for a convenient alternative to disposables or an easy way to continue enjoying your favourite SKE Crystal Pro 600 flavours, these prefilled pods provide a mess-free, affordable, and hassle-free solution.
